title: How I Built a 118-Tool Autonomous System
tweets:
🧵 Thread: How I built a 118-tool autonomous AI system that runs 24/7

No team. One developer. Production deployment.

Here's the architecture 👇

1/ The core is the NEXUS CONTROL CENTER — a web dashboard that controls everything:

• 20 categories of tools
• Each tool has a real Python handler
• All connected via MCP (Model Context Protocol)
• Accessible from any device on the network

2/ The agent fleet includes:

💰 Crypto trading (10 tools)
⚡ Passive income (8 tools)
🛡️ EU AI Act compliance (8 tools)
📱 Multi-platform comms (10 tools)
🖥️ Desktop automation (8 tools)
📊 Business intelligence (12 tools)
🎮 Competition bots (6 tools)
...and 56 more

3/ The secret sauce: MCP + A2A

MCP (Model Context Protocol) = how agents talk to tools
A2A (Agent-to-Agent) = how agents talk to each other

Result: plug in a new agent → it instantly has access to 118 capabilities

4/ Real results:

✅ Trading bot managing real Coinbase portfolio
✅ Compliance engine scanning for EU AI Act violations
✅ Content pipeline publishing to 5 platforms
✅ Freelance sniper auto-applying to Upwork
✅ 3D assets generated and published to Sketchfab

5/ The tech stack:

Python · TypeScript · Next.js
OpenAI · Gemini · Claude · Mistral · DeepSeek
Stripe · Coinbase · Supabase · Vercel
Playwright · FFmpeg · Whisper

All open protocols. No vendor lock-in.

6/ What's next:

• Malt.fr profile optimization (AI agent for freelance ranking)
• Multi-machine A2A mesh expansion
• Real-time video processing
• Voice-controlled agent dispatch
